faqs.a:
It is hereby declared as a matter of legislative determination that:
(1)
The notice provided in this article for each hearing or other action to be taken is
                  reasonably calculated to inform each interested person of any proceedings hereunder
                  which may directly and adversely affect his legally protected interests and of his
                  legally protected rights;
(2)
The powers, rights and privileges herein granted and the duties, disabilities, liabilities,
                  and immunities herein provided comply in all respects with any requirement or limitation
                  imposed by any constitutional, charter, or statutory provisions; and
(3)
For the accomplishment of these purposes, the provisions of this article shall be
                  broadly construed.
(Code 1981, § 27-2; Ord. No. 551, § 2, 5-14-1964)
State Law reference—
Legislative declaration regarding municipal improvement districts, C.R.S. § 31-25-601.
